patterns.description: Product rises from below frame, decelerates to rest. Premium standard entrance.
Package slides left or right, settles into position. Used for flanking units in family compositions.
Single luminous pulse from product base on landing. Marks the hero unit entry.
Branded bird mascot performs controlled arc flight above product, lands on artwork. Subtly animated post-landing.
Floating particles converge toward a single point — used to reveal a seal, badge, or claim element.
Branded mascot or element passes close to lens creating a foreground wipe transition. Followed by zoom recovery.
Camera remains completely static. All motion is product or element motion only. Use for LED readability.
Brief dynamic zoom follows a fast element (bird), then returns to locked hero framing. Adds energy without chaos.
Background graphic elements (particles, arcs) drift slowly. Creates depth illusion. Max speed: 5% frame width per second.
